description.value: Rossland Fine Wine is a specialty bottle shop on Rossland's main street, operated by a sommelier with over 30 years of food and beverage industry experience across top Canadian restaurants and hotels. The store carries more than 1,000 wines and runs an active wine club with exclusive tastings, new-release events, and a dedicated in-store tasting room. For cycling tourists passing through this mountain-biking hub, it offers retail wine and spirits with an online ordering option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active specialty wine and spirits retailer with a resident sommelier and wine club, matching the OSM shop=alcohol tag. The contact page reveals the real phone number (+1 250-362-2295) absent from OSM, but the site-wide address block ('123 Street Avenue, City Town, 99999') is an unfilled Squarespace template placeholder — the OSM address is therefore the best available source. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website, leaving all required criteria unconfirmable.
